# TableLab

> TableLab is a free poker bankroll tracker for cash games and tournaments, available on Android and the web. It logs sessions, records full street-by-street hand histories, runs an offline range-vs-range equity calculator, tracks player reads, and provides solver-grounded AI coaching on sessions and individual hands. Built and operated by MagpiQ, an independent software studio in Ontario, Canada.

## Key facts

- Price: Free. Core tracking, hand recorder, equity calculator, and dashboard cost nothing; AI coaching has a generous free daily allowance.
- Platforms: Android via Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pokertracker.poker_tracker) and any modern web browser at https://tablelab.app
- Privacy: No ads. Data is never sold. Records are private per-account, protected by row-level security. Data is only sent to Anthropic (Claude) when the user explicitly taps "Analyse".
- Maker: MagpiQ, a sole proprietorship based in Ontario, Canada.

## Features

- Session tracking — log cash and tournament sessions with stakes, buy-in, cash-out, table size, duration, and notes.
- Hand recorder — record full hand histories street by street, from heads-up to 9-handed, and replay them on a table.
- AI coaching — Claude explains your sessions and hands in plain English, grounded in computed equity and solver-derived GTO frequencies (where the spot is covered), never invented numbers.
- Equity calculator — range-vs-range equity with GTO presets and Monte Carlo simulation, fully offline.
- Player reads — track opponent tendencies and turn tags into rule-based insights.
- Bankroll dashboard — win rate, BB/100, profit by game type, and trends across full history.
